'''2008 Idaho State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 9 August 2008 in Logan, Utah, billed as "Idaho States (or Logan Invitational)".<ref name="sf-20910-321284">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=321284#p321284 Idaho States?], Jerba (Jaron Janson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125184205/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start120.html Internet Archive]</ref> Four players took part, and [[Geoff Dearing]] finished first and took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-20910-324490">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=324490#p324490 Idaho States?], CategoryOneGames.com, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190352/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20910-326064">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=326064#p326064 Idaho States?], itcouldbewirfs (Chris Wirfs), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190352/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' rounds 1 and 2 in the eating area ("The Hub") of the Taggart Student Center, Utah State University, 100 Old Main Hill, Logan, Utah; rounds 3 to 6 at Phoenix Games, 72 W Center Street, Logan; the final confrontation was to be played in Idaho, at Franklin<ref name="sf-20910-321284" />
* '''Dates:''' 9 August 2008<ref name="sf-20910-321284" />
* '''Time:''' 10 am<ref name="sf-20910-321284" />
* '''Format:''' announced as six rounds, with the top two able to play a final confrontation for the championship;<ref name="sf-20910-321284" /><ref name="sf-20910-323190">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=323190#p323190 Idaho States?], CategoryOneGames.com, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125184349/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref> with fewer than eight players only four games were required<ref name="sf-20910-326064" /><ref name="sf-20910-328191">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=328191#p328191 Idaho States?], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190352/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Entry fee:''' $10, collected by [[James Lewis]]<ref name="sf-20910-323190" />
* '''Tournament director:''' three-judge system<ref name="sf-20910-319604">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=319604#p319604 Idaho States?], CategoryOneGames.com, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (30 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125184205/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start120.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Winner:''' [[Geoff Dearing]]<ref name="sf-20910-324490" />

== Organization ==

In May 2008 the forum user CategoryOneGames.com suggested holding an Idaho state championship in Pocatello, closer for the Utah players,<ref name="sf-20910-302112">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=302112#p302112 Idaho States?], CategoryOneGames.com, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183830/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910.html Internet Archive]</ref> and Empire Comics Cards & Collectibles in Pocatello was considered as a venue.<ref name="sf-20910-303860">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303860#p303860 Idaho States?], CategoryOneGames.com, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190433/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref> On 30 July he wrote that Idaho States would not happen unless the Logan players ran it, that Logan was 19 miles south of Franklin, Idaho, and that they would cross the border for the final confrontation if needed.<ref name="sf-20910-319604" /> [[Jaron Janson]] posted the venues and schedule on 4 August.<ref name="sf-20910-321284" />

CategoryOneGames.com, who could not attend, sent about 50 rares, a Reflections II pack for the winner and other packs as prizes, with three full-colour sheets of the virtual card slips of Virtual Sets 1 to 15 and, for everyone, slips of the unreleased Mara Jade card.<ref name="sf-20910-323190" />

== Results ==

CategoryOneGames.com posted the results on 12 August 2008, with game-by-game results for each player:<ref name="sf-20910-324490" />

{| class="wikitable"
|+ Full standings (4 players)
! # !! Player !! Points (differential)
|-
| 1 || [[Geoff Dearing]] || 10 (+30)
|-
| 2 || [[Jaron Janson]] || 6 (+46)
|-
| 3 || [[James Lewis]] || 4 (−23)
|-
| 4 || David Gwilliam || 2 (−53)
|}

He was unsure whether a four-player event could count as a state championship.<ref name="sf-20910-324490" /> [[Chris Wirfs]] answered that Dearing had earned the bye, because the Players Committee's tournament guide required only four games with fewer than eight players,<ref name="sf-20910-326064" /> and Cedric (simone89) confirmed that four rounds was legal.<ref name="sf-20910-328191" />
